principle: Not checked is not unsupported. Not verifiable is not incorrect. Pass-through is not verified.

coverage_modes.FULL_EVIDENCE_CHECK: The value is matched against the bound evidence window by the deterministic pattern that defines the quantity, including unit conversion where the source unit is explicit.
coverage_modes.NORMALIZATION_AWARE_CHECK: The verdict is read from the normalization record produced by prediction-normalizer-v1. The verifier does not resolve anything itself.
coverage_modes.LITERAL_EVIDENCE_CHECK: The value is matched literally against the bound evidence window after Unicode, whitespace and punctuation normalization, with word-boundary awareness. No fuzzy matching, edit distance, token overlap or synonym guessing.
coverage_modes.EXPLICIT_STEREO_CHECK: Only stereochemical descriptors stated explicitly in the evidence are used. Configuration is never inferred from ee, er, catalyst sense, structure drawings or literature precedent.
coverage_modes.NOT_CHECKED_V1: No verifier exists for this field in v1. The raw answer passes through unchecked and is never called verified.

statuses.supported: the bound evidence directly supports the value
statuses.partial: the evidence supports part of the value
statuses.unsupported: the evidence contradicts the value, or evidence integrity failed
statuses.unresolved: an identity was mentioned but could not be resolved from the source
statuses.ambiguous: the source supports more than one mutually exclusive reading
statuses.not_checked_v1: the field has no verifier in this contract
statuses.not_verifiable_v1: the field has a verifier, but this case's evidence representation does not allow a reliable verdict

fields.limitations: reaction is a compound semantic field (class, transformation, substrate-to-product relationship, chemistry category) and there is no reaction canonicalizer in v1. A substring test against the evidence would not be scientific verification, so none is performed.

Only a literal mention in the bound evidence can support a catalyst. A metal name alone never supports a full catalyst identity, a metal plus ligand is never assembled into one, a precatalyst is never equated with the active catalyst, and a catalyst number is never resolved across papers. Without a literal match the verdict is not_verifiable_v1, never unsupported.

The verdict mirrors the normalization status: resolved becomes supported, and unresolved or ambiguous are passed through as they are. Without a normalization record the ligand is unresolved with reason normalization_missing.

The check recognizes the controlled substrate-class vocabulary of the candidate builder. A named compound outside that vocabulary is reported unsupported by the current implementation even when the source names it, so substrate verdicts are conservative on compound-level answers.

Only an explicit textual product mention or an explicit product label in the evidence can support a product. A product expressed only as a drawn structure in a scheme is not verifiable from text, and the verdict is not_verifiable_v1, never unsupported.
Matches a numeric pressure in the evidence, converting bar, atm, psi, MPa and kPa when the unit is explicit. A pressure stated only in a scheme image is not visible to a text-only check.
Numeric degrees Celsius only. A non-numeric report such as room temperature is not matched and is not coerced.
Hours only. A time stated in minutes in the source is not converted by the check.
Recognizes the controlled solvent vocabulary of the candidate builder. A solvent outside that vocabulary, or a mixture written as a ratio, is reported unsupported by the current implementation.
Matches a percentage written as yield. Conversion reported instead of yield is not matched.
Only an ee in percent is matched. An er ratio is not converted and is reported not_verifiable_v1 by the chain runner rather than being checked as an ee.

Only explicit descriptors count: (R), (S), R- or S-configured, R or S configuration, racemic, and an explicitly named major enantiomer. Matching is word-boundary aware so a stray letter never counts. When the evidence reports only an ee or er value the verdict is not_verifiable_v1. unsupported is used only when the evidence states a different configuration explicitly.

coverage_summary.note: Field counts are a summary only. The reported denominator is verifier_coverage_rate over candidate x field units, not a fields fraction.
